page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-48 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 48 dedicated virtual CPUs. The instance is equipped with 378.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 7.88 GB per vCPU.

This configuration does not include local storage, requiring reliance on network-attached storage options for persistent data. Additionally, the instance features zero GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type.

The c4d-highmem-48 offers a high-density memory configuration relative to its compute allocation, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the overhead of excessive CPU cores. This resource balance is designed for memory-intensive applications, including databases, in-memory caching layers, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
